career_ladder.note: Sub-Inspectors in West Bengal Police serve as primary investigating officers across police stations, detective departments, and armed battalions. Promotion pathways are governed by the Police Regulations of Bengal (PRB), West Bengal Police Service rules, and the West Bengal Services (Revision of Pay and Allowances) Rules, 2019 (ROPA 2019). Outstanding officers can reach the West Bengal Police Service (WBPS) cadre and receive nomination to the Indian Police Service (IPS).

exam_scheme.note: The selection scheme for West Bengal Police Sub-Inspector (Unarmed Branch) and Sub-Inspector (Armed Branch) comprises four successive stages: (i) Preliminary Examination (Screening, 200 marks), (ii) Physical Measurement Test (PMT) & Physical Efficiency Test (PET) (Qualifying), (iii) Final Combined Competitive Examination (Conventional Descriptive, 200 marks), and (iv) Personality Test (Interview, 30 marks with minimum 8 marks qualifying). Final merit is compiled strictly on the basis of marks obtained in the Final Combined Competitive Examination and the Personality Test (Total: 230 marks).

financial_package.note: West Bengal Police Sub-Inspectors are remunerated under Pay Level 10 of the West Bengal Services (Revision of Pay and Allowances) Rules, 2019 (ROPA 2019), corresponding to pre-revised Pay Band-3 (₹7,100 – ₹37,600 with Grade Pay ₹3,900). Starting basic pay is ₹32,100.
financial_package.pay_source_label: West Bengal Services (Revision of Pay and Allowances) Rules, 2019, Level 10, and WBPRB Employment Notification
financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated on ROPA 2019 Level 10 entry basic pay of ₹32,100 with project constant 58% Dearness Allowance (₹18,618), 12% House Rent Allowance (₹3,852), Medical Allowance (₹500/month), plus statutory police officer allowances including ration subsidy and kit/washing maintenance. Deductions include West Bengal Professional Tax (PTax ₹200) and GPF/NPS contributions (~10% basic+DA).
official_perks: Sub-Inspector government family residential quarters or 12% House Rent Allowance (HRA)
Coverage under the West Bengal Health Scheme (WBHS) for officer and family dependents
Departmental motorcycle patrol mobility and fuel allowance for field investigative duty
Uniform grant, annual kit maintenance, and holster/badge upkeep allowance
Special investigative allowances and compensatory risk pay during law & order operations
Leave Travel Concession (LTC) and leave encashment under West Bengal Service Rules
